♥ Hello Dream Community ♥


0- Do I meet the requirements?
Yes I do meet the requirements for becoming a Test-Admin for Dream server, I have became active alot, I pay attention to alot of deatils and I became more friendly and approachable person
1- What is your name? Real & Ingame
My real name is Michal and my in game name is Oxygen


2- How old are you?
Currently I'm 1 month away from being 16 years old.
3- Why do you want to join our administrative team?
I want to become Test-Admin for Dream server for many reasons, there are players that are rude some and some of them can get very disrespectful when admins are not available and some mic abuse and others 2vs1, I want to stop that and also bring fun and enjoyment to the server, I think I will be a good "Fill in" when admins are not available
4- How long have you been playing on our servers?
I have been playing for 5,175 minutes on the Dream knife server which gives us around 87 hours which gave me a lot of time to know most of the players that play on this community and all of them are just great.
5- What are your favorite hobbies or pastimes?
My hobbies are I like going mountain biking in rough terrains, I like spending good time with my family and friends and I'm a lot of my free time I spend my hours with this community because I feel like part of it it's been great for me till now and sure it will be like this for a very very long time.
6- Do you think of yourself as mature?
I do think of myself as mature because I have improved a lot since my last application, I have been helping DooDoo and Fiddles with their work as admin usually when players were breaking the rules I usually warned them and when they carried on I got one of the administrators to sort it out.
7- Have you gained experience as an administrator before?
I don't have past experience as administrator but for sure DooDoo ( Likes me a lot and is keen to help me improve as test-admin to my maximum ) or Fiddles will be keen enough to help me which I really appreciate.
8- When do you play? (timetable of your average week)

Monday Tuesday Wednesday Thursday Friday Saturday Sunday 15:30-22:30 16:30-22:30 16:30-22:30 16:30-22:30 16:30-2:45 All Day All Day


9- User 1 calls user 2 a "cunt" and proceeds to insult him further - what actions would you take?
If I know they are friends I would usually allow it, but when it get's too excessive I would warn player 1 if he continues with such a behavior I would mute him until end of the map if he carries on with disrespect I would time him out, if he comes back and starts abusing me I would have to have to ban him for least of 10 minutes to let him chill down and rethink what he is doing. If I was not on the server and some player called me to the place I would interview both players by talking to the user 2 first listening to his side of a story then I would listen to user 1 and after that I would take appropriate action of banning one of the players for at least of 5-10 minutes.
10- Strengths

  • I'm always keen to help players and admins.
  • I can pay attention to details.
  • I'm respectful towards players.
  • I listen to every players words they say.
    11- Weaknesses
  • I'm not always perfect I make some mistakes as sometimes not paying a lot of attention but that's when I'm extremely tired or had a bad day.
  • Sometimes players don't understand me as I speak too fast and my mother tongue is not English
  • Patience as I always want to help everyone as soon as possible.
    12- Conclusion / Closing remark

Thank you for reading my applications I hope I have improved a lot and showed myself worth enough if I ever become a Test-Admin I promise not to let anyone of you down as this community is the one that attracted me the most and helped me with a lot, Thank You once more for reading my application hope you liked it and see you in-game. PEACE ♥
Kind Regards
Michal "OxygeN" J.

Dear Oxygen 🙂


Well, first of all, it is very lovely to hear you having the determination and eagerness the re-apply to be one of our team (even though your patience is lacking, its still nice to see that you really want to help the community).


Well, as before and always, I'll make a pros and cons list for you and make a final judgement at the end:


Pros:
1. You are very persistent in helping the community.
2. Your eagerness to help and support Dream is sensational - it seems like you really do intend to help.
3. Your attitude and behaviour has drastically changed and matured in the past weeks (not necessarily fully matured but you're progressing).
4. You have shown to me that you are able to maintain calm and tolerate disrespectful behaviour towards you.
5. You are generally a very useful and helpful "fill-in" as to when the knife admins are unavailable.
6. Your activity on the game; forums and teamspeak is still phenomenal.
7. You still have a very interesting array of interests and hobbies.
8. You seem to have generally a lot of free time at hands.


As you can see, your positives have definitely increased since your last application, which definitely show that you are improving.


However, onto the cons:
1. You claim you have attention to detail, this is clearly not shown as you have still a few spelling and grammatical mistakes throughout your application even after numerous amounts of editing.
2. Even though your activity has been increasing, I feel like as though it hasn't been increasing by a lot through the past few weeks, maybe you need the title as an admin to get motivated but who knows!
3. In my honest opinion, your punishments are a bit too generous and forgiving. You need to understand that people don't change after 10 minutes, if they fail to calm down after a kick, then 30 minutes is the minimum, recommended amount to allow them to cool off (if its their first ban).
4. I remember you stating the fact that you sometimes log off in order to calm down if you get too worked out, this is obviously the best choice, however, I believe that admins should remain calm throughout any situation.
5. Your lack of patience is definitely a downfall but I do understand that you want to help out ASAP.


Well, that's it! As we can see, the pros outweighed the cons by a moderate amount so to be honest, I believe that if you just make some tweaks to yourself and get that motivation of becoming an admin, then you will be surely a true asset to our Dream Team and to the community (and hopefully not admin abusing as you PROMISED that you wouldn't let us down).


So for me, it is a YES 😄


I wish you the very best of luck,
Doo Doo
